stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Russland greift erneut Odessa und Kyjiw an

en.title: War against Ukraine: Russia attacks Odessa and Kyiv again
en.summary: Russia conducted fresh attacks on the Ukrainian cities of Odessa and Kyiv, with reports of major explosions in the capital and several injuries in the port city.

stories.title: Wahl in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: So lief das TV-Duell von Manuela Schwesig und Leif-Erik Holm im NDR

en.title: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Election: TV Debate Between Manuela Schwesig and Leif-Erik Holm on NDR
en.summary: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's minister president Manuela Schwesig and AfD top candidate Leif-Erik Holm faced off in a televised debate on NDR, highlighting the dilemma public broadcasters face when interviewing a party that questions their legitimacy.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: US-Kongress beschließt Gesetz für Russland-Sanktionen

en.title: News blog on the Ukraine war: US Congress passes legislation for Russia sanctions
en.summary: The US Congress has enacted legislation imposing sanctions on Russian politicians and companies while restricting Russian oil and gas exports to limit funding for Russia's military operations.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Trump droht EU wegen geplanter Annäherung an Kanada

en.title: USA-Newsblog: Trump threatens EU over planned rapprochement with Canada
en.summary: US President Trump called a plan to make Canada an associated member of the European Union ridiculous and threatened to impose high tariffs or halt trade with Europe in response.

stories.title: Donald Trump droht EU wegen Kanada-Annäherung mit »sehr hohen Zöllen«

en.title: Donald Trump threatens EU over Canada rapprochement with "very high tariffs"
en.summary: Trump criticized a proposed deepening of the EU-Canada partnership as ridiculous and warned of consequences if he views it as a hostile act.

stories.title: US-Kongress stimmt für schärfere Sanktionen gegen Russland

en.title: US Congress votes for stricter sanctions against Russia
en.summary: The US House of Representatives approved new sanctions against Russia following Senate approval, marking a significant measure to support Ukraine since Trump took office. The measure awaits presidential signature.

en.title: US Federal Reserve raises key interest rate for first time since 2023
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate by one quarter point to a range of 3.75 to 4.00 percent as part of efforts to combat persistent inflation.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: Trump droht EU mit Handelsstopp wegen Annäherung an Kanada

en.title: USA under Trump: Trump threatens EU with trade halt over rapprochement with Canada
en.summary: Trump threatened the EU with a trade halt in response to its closer ties with Canada.

stories.title: Ukraine-Krieg: US-Kongress erhöht mit Sanktionsgesetz den Druck auf Russland

en.title: Ukraine War: US Congress increases pressure on Russia with sanctions law
en.summary: The US House of Representatives voted 262 to 159 in favor of legislation to impose stronger sanctions on Russia. The measure now awaits President Trump's signature.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: US-Kongress stimmt für verschärfte Russland-Sanktionen

en.title: Live Blog Ukraine War: US Congress votes for tightened Russia sanctions
en.summary: The House of Representatives joined the Senate in approving enhanced sanctions legislation against Russia. Ukraine reported successful testing of new drone defense systems and a Russian drone downed over Lithuania.

stories.title: Wahl in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: So lief das TV-Duell zwischen Schwesig und Holm

en.title: Election in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: TV debate between Schwesig and Holm
en.summary: SPD candidate Schwesig and AfD challenger Holm participated in a televised debate during the final campaign push before Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's state election on Sunday.

stories.title: Nutzfahrzeugindustrie: Bosch – Konkurrenz durch chinesische Hersteller nimmt zu

en.title: Commercial vehicle industry: Bosch – competition from Chinese manufacturers increasing
en.summary: Bosch's business has faced significant pressure recently, with the head of its mobility division noting growing competition from Chinese manufacturers. He is calling for action from the EU.

stories.title: Gehälter: Was ist beim Gehalt noch drin – trotz Krise?

en.title: Salaries: What's still possible in wages - despite the crisis?
en.summary: A consulting firm analysis examines how companies' compensation budgets are developing and what salary expectations employees can realistically have in the current environment.

stories.title: Gastkommentar: Der Aufbruch beginnt bei uns – worauf warten wir noch?

en.title: Guest Commentary: The Awakening Begins With Us – What Are We Waiting For?
en.summary: Nicola Leibinger-Kammüller argues that achieving economic and mental transformation requires returning to a commitment to freedom and confidence in businesses.

stories.title: Immobilien: Große Investoren fürchten vor allem eine Entwicklung

en.title: Real Estate: Major Investors Fear Above All One Development
en.summary: The property transaction market has not yet experienced the significant turnaround the industry hoped for. A leading global market player shares expectations about market trends for 2027.
